name: dsh-web-recorder
description: Record a user-guided browser session — clicks, inputs, navigation and network traffic — over the Chrome DevTools Protocol, then export a Markdown timeline (report.md) and a structured events.jsonl log to reverse-engineer web flows and build API-level skills.
scope: Records and summarizes a human-driven Chromium-family browser session into report.md + events.jsonl. It does not drive/automate the browser for the user, capture request/response bodies, store input value contents (only lengths), download a browser, or support Firefox/WebKit. Requires an installed Chrome/Edge/Chromium on the host.
